prTitle: Add OpenAI SDK Audio Speech support

content.motivation: This change introduces auto-configuration for OpenAI's SDK-based audio speech model. It enables Spring AI to leverage OpenAI's text-to-speech capabilities through its Java SDK, providing a seamless way for developers to integrate speech synthesis into their Spring Boot applications. This includes defining properties, configurations, and integrating with the existing Spring AI framework.
goodPoints: Comprehensive auto-configuration for OpenAI SDK's audio speech model.
Clear separation of concerns with dedicated properties classes (`OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechProperties`).
Well-defined integration tests (`OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechAutoConfigurationIT`) covering basic functionality, property application, and enabling/disabling scenarios.
Thorough unit tests for the `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechModel` class, including builder patterns, option merging, and edge cases.
Support for various OpenAI SDK-specific options like model, voice, response format, and speed.
Metadata extraction for rate limiting is implemented and tested.
Code follows Spring Boot auto-configuration patterns.
badPoints: The `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechModel.call` method throws a raw `RuntimeException` instead of a more specific exception type when reading the audio stream fails.
The `logger` field in `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechModel` is not following the constant naming convention (should be `LOG` or `LOGGER`).
content.suggestion:
1. Refactor the `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechModel.call` method to catch `IOException` and wrap it in a more specific custom exception (e.g., `AudioGenerationException` or `SpeechServiceException`) instead of a raw `RuntimeException`. This improves error handling and allows callers to catch specific exceptions.
2. Rename the `logger` field to `LOG` or `LOGGER` to adhere to common Java logging conventions for constants.

details: Uses `@AutoConfiguration` to mark the class as an auto-configuration.
Uses `@EnableConfigurationProperties` to bind `OpenAiSdkConnectionProperties` and `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechProperties`.
Uses `@ConditionalOnProperty` to enable the configuration only when `spring.ai.model.audio.speech` is set to `openai-sdk`.
Defines a `@Bean` for `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechModel` with `@ConditionalOnMissingBean`.
Leverages `OpenAiSdkAutoConfigurationUtil.resolveConnectionProperties` to merge common and speech-specific properties.
Creates `OpenAIClient` using `OpenAiSdkSetup.setupSyncClient`.
Builds `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechModel` using its builder, passing the client and default options from `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechProperties`.
Extends `AbstractOpenAiSdkOptions` to inherit common connection properties.
Uses `@ConfigurationProperties` with prefix `spring.ai.openai-sdk.audio.speech`.
Defines default values for model, voice, response format, and speed using `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechOptions.builder()`.
Uses `@NestedConfigurationProperty` for the `options` field.
Implements the `TextToSpeechModel` interface.
Uses a private constructor and a `Builder` class for instantiation, following the builder pattern.
Injects or creates `OpenAIClient` via `OpenAiSdkSetup.setupSyncClient`.
The `call` method constructs `SpeechCreateParams` from merged options and calls `openAiClient.audio().speech().create()`.
Handles response body as `InputStream` and reads into `byte[]`.
Metadata extraction for rate limits is integrated using `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechResponseMetadata.from(headers)`.
The `stream` method is a placeholder, returning the non-streamed result as a single-element Flux due to current SDK limitations.
Provides `getDefaultOptions()` which returns the `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechOptions`.
Implements `mergeOptions` and `merge` methods to combine runtime prompt options with default options.
Extends `AbstractOpenAiSdkOptions`.
Defines enums for `Voice` and `AudioResponseFormat` with corresponding string values.
Sets default values for model, voice, response format, and speed.
Provides a `Builder` class for creating instances.
The `merge` method in the builder handles merging options from different `TextToSpeechOptions` implementations.
Implements `copy()` for creating a deep copy of options.
Extends `TextToSpeechResponseMetadata`.
Parses rate limit headers (`x-ratelimit-limit-requests`, `x-ratelimit-remaining-requests`, etc.) from `com.openai.core.http.Headers`.
Uses helper methods `getHeaderAsLong` and `getHeaderAsDuration` for robust header value parsing.
Creates `OpenAiSdkRateLimit` instances or `EmptyRateLimit`.
The `from` method constructs the metadata object.
Implements the `RateLimit` interface.
Holds request and token limits, remaining counts, and reset times.
Constructor initializes all fields.
Provides getters for all rate limit properties.

issues.title: Raw RuntimeException thrown on IO Error
issues.detail: The `OpenAiSdkAudioSpeechModel.call` method catches `IOException` during audio stream reading and throws a raw `RuntimeException`. It is preferable to throw a more specific exception or wrap the `IOException` in a custom, domain-specific exception for better error handling.

issues.title: Logger field naming convention violation
issues.detail: The static logger field `logger` does not follow the common convention of using `LOG` or `LOGGER` (all caps with underscore).
